queries: MATCH (n) WITH labels(n)[0] AS name, count(*) AS c RETURN 'node' AS kind, name, c UNION ALL MATCH ()-[r]->() WITH type(r) AS name, count(*) AS c RETURN 'rel' AS kind, name, c
MATCH (c)-[:OWNS]->(s:Subsidiary) RETURN coalesce(c.ticker, c.name, c.entity_key) AS owner, count(s) AS subsidiaries, count(DISTINCT s.country) AS countries ORDER BY subsidiaries DESC
MATCH (c)-[:OWNS]->(s:Subsidiary) WHERE c.ticker = 'MSFT' OR c.ticker = 'CASY' OR s.name CONTAINS 'Israel' OR ... RETURN c.ticker, s.name, s.country, s.jurisdiction_raw ORDER BY owner, name
